notes: S4 W2-C vegetation acceptance shots (pnpm qa --set s4-c): the Mirkwood sweep at 75 / 110 / 220 / 400 km across the far canopy shell band (shellConfig.ts: the band is in screen pixels of a 0.6 km crown, 9 → 5 px — at 1280×720 and 35° ≈ 76–137 km, the shell leading it and full by ≈ 104 km; at 1080p ≈ 114–205 km; the preview tier retires at 0.7× those distances). Canopy-patch instances sink into the terrain's canopy shell, the forest-edge ring stands at every distance; no seam, no pop, same colour. A low Shire close-up of field trees and copses, Ithilien at hero range. Owned by the vegetation module.

shots.note: Mirkwood at 75 km (720p): the target just before the band — canopy instances over the dark underlay, the shell only beyond (from ≈ 68 km)
Mirkwood at 110 km (720p): the target mid-band — instances in front sinking into the shell, the shell full beyond ≈ 104 km (no seam)
Mirkwood at 220 km (720p): past the band — the shell carries the forest (crown domes, stands, rust accents), the edge ring stands
Mirkwood at 400 km: the shell carries the forest (colour, stand tone), the road and the hill scars closed to dark seams, edge trees stay
field and hedgerow trees, copses at hero range: asymmetric broadleaf crowns on visible trunks and limbs, believable size against the hedges
Ithilien groves at hero range: broadleaf groves with dark columnar cypresses
